provenance.native_cea_banner: NASA-GLENN CHEMICAL EQUILIBRIUM PROGRAM CEA, OCTOBER 18, 2002; NASA RP-1311 Parts I (1994) and II (1996)
provenance.cstar_raw_definition: CEA reference C*: gc*Pinj/App(2)*aw; App(2) is Fortran 1-based, Python rockt.app[1] = Pinj/Pinf
provenance.cstar_injector_definition: Cstar_raw*rockt.app[1] = Pinj*At/mdot, checked independently against throat density*sonic velocity
provenance.ambient_definition: Isp_vac - Pambient/Pinj * epsilon * Cstar_injector / g0, only epsilon 5 and attached screen
provenance.optimization: 101 point full-range scan then SciPy bounded refinement of every local grid maximum, xatol=1e-10 (CEA numerical resolution still limits significant digits)
provenance.cea_input_resolution: Scalar O/F is written using %f (6 decimal places) by installed RocketCEA 1.2.3; displayed optimizer coordinates within the same rounded CEA card are equivalent
provenance.scope: Ideal thermochemical objective comparison, fixed Pc/CR/epsilon/reactant cards; no experiment, thermal, injector, structural or whole-engine optimum claimed
